entries.title: Homeroom Reminder
entries.text: All Students: As a reminder, homeroom is a class period. Please do not use phones during homeroom. Thank you!

entries.title: Christian Worship Music
entries.text: Join as a community to praise God through contemporary Christian worship music! Today, Tues, 11/3, at 12:15 pm (meeting/lunch period) on the Chapel Lanai (Ewa side of the chapel). All faculty, staff, and students are welcome. God bless!

entries.title: Here's the Tea on Mental Health
entries.text: Want to get to know one of our Upper School Counselors better? Drop by for an open chat with Mr. Higa ’03 in the Wong-Trainor Lobby (Dorm Lobby) during lunch tomorrow, Wednesday 11/4. He’ll be sharing his education and career journey and answering your questions about mental health. Sweet treat provided while supplies last. It's open to all all US students.

CELEBRATE "INTERNATIONAL RED HEAD DAY" Nov 5 by coming to opening night of the 'Iolani Dramatic Players' production of ANNIE! Last chance to secure your seats for ANNIE at MAMIYA THEATRE ON THE ST. LOUIS CAMPUS! (Not Hawaii Theatre!) Best availability is this THURS, Nov 5th at 6pm. Some seats are still available for Friday, Nov 6th at 7pm. SATURDAY Nov 7th is SOLD OUT! All tickets are $10.00 each. Ticket Link: Annie Ticket Link

entries.title: Spring Musical Auditions
entries.text: 'Iolani Dramatic Players Announces Auditions for our Spring Musical at Hawaii Theatre: HADESTOWN. Auditions are Thurs and Fri Nov 12 and 13, 3:15-5:30. Performance Dates are Feb 18, 19, and 20, 2027. Rehearsals begin Mon, Nov 30, and run Monday-Friday from 3:15-5:30. No rehearsals over Winter Break. If you have any questions please contact: asakaguchi@iolani.org or mchicks@iolani.org Audition Registration Form Link: https://forms.gle/Kg3TL2Zc8h24htWW9 Audition Materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JrWtv2_umjiZY3qbBTUUSHVfWZ49Gsu7?usp=sharing

entries.title: Imua ʻIolani Quarter 2 Survey
entries.text: Hey Raiders, Imua wants to hear from you in our quarterly survey! We want to know: What are your favorite foods from the One Team Wagon and from Trader Joe's? Should the U.S. government restrict social media usage for minors? And what sexual health topics should 'Iolani teach about more? Complete this survey by Friday to help represent the voice of the students. The survey should only take a few minutes.

GRADUATION SUIT FITTING - FRIDAY 11/6 - SETO HALL - Please sign up for a 10- minute suit fitting appointment during your free period/lunch/after school here: Appointment Sign-Up Link. Slot times will become unavailable when filled (max 5 students per time slot). Email cco@iolani.org or come to College Counseling Office with any questions. Thank you!

entries.title: Big/little Sibling 8/12
entries.text: The fun continues with our first get together! 8th Graders: Stay in your homeroom. 12th Graders: After attendance and announcements, head over to your little sibling’s homeroom to meet up! Then, during the Meeting/Lunch Period, find your sibling by the Weinberg Fountain and choose your adventure: Lower Gym – Basketball & Volleyball Sullivan 3rd Floor Seminar Roo0m – ESports Center Courtyard – Games, music & chill time

entries.title: Food4thought Acai-bowl Party
entries.text: It’s November, which means it’s time to kick off Food4Thought! Help us celebrate this K-12, ONE TEAM effort to fight hunger. The C+CE Student Leaders will have free acai bowls for all of you who come out to learn how you can get involved. See you tomorrow, Wed, 11/3 at the Pā, during the meeting period and lunch!

entries.title: Biology Club
entries.text: Interested in participating in biology competitions like USA Biology Olympiad? Come to the BioClub meeting on Thurs, Nov 5, lunch, I-101! We’ll introduce some biology-related competitions that you can sign up for through interactive activities. Snacks provided :)

entries.title: Future Business Leaders of America
entries.text: FBLA is excited to announce our upcoming school conference on Nov 24, with the award ceremony on Nov 25! Students can compete in a variety of events, with overall top scorers receiving a $50 gift card and finalists earning medals and certificates. ALL (you do not need to be in FBLA) interested students are encouraged to register and showcase their skills. Please register using this link by Nov 15: https://forms.gle/CzYHhN7MZPiWEwkw9 Please contact klp2801@iolani.org or ec2801@iolani.org for more information.
